title: CannonRTP
description: Fancy high performance random teleport plugin that blasts your players to a random location in the map!
body:
Note: CannonRTP trailer coming soon, for now here's a short video showing how it works!

# 🟠 About CannonRTP: **CannonRTP** transforms random teleportation into a cinematic experience. Instead of instantly appearing somewhere new, players step into a cannon, watch it calibrate their destination, and get launched across the world. As players enter the cannon, they are lifted into the air while the system locks in a safe destination, complete with coordinate previews. Once ready, the cannon fires—blasting them skyward before dropping them above their landing zone with smooth descent and impact effects. # 🟠 Main Features: * **Fully Configurable Cannons:** Place cannons anywhere and set custom RTP distances, target worlds, and search centers per unit. * **Safety First:** Built-in safe location checks ensure players never land in a wall or over lava. * **Deep Integration:** Full support for popular protection plugins like WorldGuard, Towny, Lands, and more. * **Total Customization:** Everything from timing to particles and sounds can be adjusted to match your server’s aesthetic. * **Visual Flexibility:** Supports custom cannon models using [**FreeMinecraftModels**](https://nightbreak.io/plugin/freeminecraftmodels/) and [**ResourcePackManager**](https://nightbreak.io/plugin/resourcepackmanager/) with an automatic fallback to particle visuals if no models are installed. * **Quick Setup:** Includes a ready-to-use example cannon to get you started immediately. # 🟠 How to Setup: 1. **Put the CannonRTP.jar into your server** and **restart your server** 2. Download the content your want from the additional downloads and put it, **without unzipping**, into the **~plugins/CannonRTP/imports** folder 3. Do **/cannonrtp reload** or **restart your server**. Restarting is recommended. 4. You're done! **Important:** a default example cannon will be placed at your server’s spawn location. You can find the config for this cannon in plugins\CannonRTP\cannons\example_world_cannon.yml, where you can disable it or change its location. # 🟠 Managing Cannons: **Creation:** To place a new cannon, stand where you want it to be and run /cannonrtp create . **Removal:** To remove a cannon, simply run /cannonrtp delete . **Requirements:** Minecraft version 1.21.4+ is required. # 🟠 Additional downloads:

Or create your own content by following the documentation!
